subject: the same dog at the glass door
action: raise both front paws toward the glass door, then lower them
before_state: that dog's two front paws are down on or near the floor, not raised toward the glass door
after_state: that dog's two front paws are visibly raised together toward the glass door; the hind paws may stay on the floor or leave it
exclusion: walking near the door, a single stepping paw, and continued front-paws-up pose are not new events; a new count requires a visible return to front-paws-down first
